title: Coordenador De Marketing Hands-On (Remoto)
description:
Overview


Atuar em conceituada empresa do ramo de semijoias.


Responsibilities



  • Coordenar ações de marketing online e offline.

  • Coordenar calendário do e-commerce com criação de campanhas específicas para as datas mais relevantes.

  • Planejar campanhas (conteúdo, mídia paga, automação) com OKRs claros.

  • Desenhar e otimizar funis completos (atração, nutrição, conversão), integrando social, anúncios, e-mail e outros.

  • Garantir performance: ROAS, CAC, crescimento orgânico e NPS do cliente.

  • Exigir padrão estético impecável (design, copy, vídeo).

  • Ser ponte sênior com o cliente: monthly review, relatórios insights-driven.

  • Liderar o squad: distribuir tarefas, remover impedimentos, acompanhar de perto a produção.

  • Hands-on sempre que preciso (copy, segmentação de Ads, ajustes em LP).


Qualifications



  • 6+ anos em marketing digital com cases comprovados (ex.: ROAS = 3, CAC reduzido, growth orgânico expressivo).

  • Domínio real de mídia orgânica e paga (Meta/Google) e funis/ automação (HubSpot, ActiveCampaign etc.).

  • Copywriting persuasivo e leitura de dados (GA4, UTMs, dashboards).

  • Visão T-shaped: entende de social, design, funil, analytics e quer aprender sempre.

  • Energia de dono(a): resolve, prioriza, decide.

  • Inglês fluente.

  • Diferenciais: SEO on-page, Webflow/WordPress básico.

  • Gestão de orçamentos > R$ 100k/mês.

  • Certificações Meta/Google/HubSpot.

  • Cultura NOVA: alta exigência, aprendizado constante, crescimento rápido.


Benefits & Expectations


Salário competitivo + bônus por resultado (faixa discutida na 1ª etapa).


Trilha rápida para Gerente de Marketing (12-24 meses, de acordo com a performance).


Agência enxuta e em escala — suas ideias saem do papel em dias, não em meses.


About NOVA & Process


NOVA nasceu para ser disruptiva: agência 100% Remote-First pode entregar resultados melhores que operações presenciais.


Por que essa vaga é diferente? Impacto imediato: você tocará a estratégia 360° de contas nacionais e internacionais, sendo o "mini-CMO" do time.


Processo relâmpago / Início imediato.


Como candidatar-se


Envie CV + deck de case/portfolio (antes & depois, números) por email até 30/05. Em um documento à parte, no mesmo email, responda as perguntas abaixo:



  1. Quando você cria a copy de uma página de vendas ou landing page, quais elementos considera essenciais para gerar conversão?

  2. Ao criar conteúdos para redes sociais, como você decide o formato ideal (post, reels, carrossel), frequência e copy?

  3. Quando um conteúdo não performa como esperado, quais dados você analisa primeiro e como decide se ajusta ou mantém a estratégia?


Etapas subsequentes: Triagem (24h) → entrevista com recrutador → entrevista com founders → desafio prático → oferta.

Company Description

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

THE TEAM

Our Global Pricing & Market Access (PMA) team at Navlin is a dynamic, international group that combines deep inhouse expertise with real-time intelligence—from pricing and HTA updates to regulatory news—via Navlin’s industry-benchmark platform. Empowered by advanced price-management software and launch-sequence simulation tools, we deliver strategic, well-informed recommendations on pricing and access for our clients.

Composed of top talent from across Europe, our multicultural team blends local market nuance with creative synergy. We embrace a flexible remote-working model—fully supported by robust IT tools—and maintain satellite offices in London, Berlin, and Milan, freely accessible to all team members. Our team is rapidly expanding with consistent year-on-year growth.

Our project portfolio includes critical initiatives such as, among others, launch sequencing and pricing strategies for ATMPs and orphan drugs, indication-expansion planning, LOE strategy, forecasting, and asset due diligence—spanning Europe and global markets. While a dedicated team oversees U.S. initiatives, we lead global efforts across Europe, APAC, and LATAM.

We also collaborate closely with EVERSANA’s internal functions—commercial, HEOR, medical affairs, and others— in global launch execution projects, ensuring PMA remains central to global launch execution of new assets

THE POSITION

The Consultant, Global Pricing and Market Access position will be involved in delivering client consultancy projects and helping to manage project-related analytics, data and tools available through our industry platform Navlin or dedicated secondary and primary research. The Consultant will ensure that tasks within client projects or internal activities are delivered to schedule, while maintaining the highest level of quality and value expectations.

The Consultant will lead research and analysis focused around: pricing, market access launch strategy, competitor research, value-based pricing analyses, HTA, etc. The Consultant will be involved in identifying client needs and problems and implementing robust strategic and data driven solutions, while managing own workload to prepare the client deliverables. In addition, the Consultant will also contribute to business development through the development of proposals. Activities will be executed under the guidance of an Engagement Manager, mainly remotely due to remote team composition. In some cities with physical EVERSANA offices, the Consultant is fully able to use the company office, as well.

The role is home office based, (full-time position), located in Italy, Remote.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Our consultants are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of the project team. These results are achieved by:

  • Designing and executing client analyses and deliverables

  • Developing client reports and presentations and delivery of all or significant portions of findings to client

  • Providing follow-up with client after project deliverable has been completed to ensure client satisfaction

  • Leveraging business experience and acumen in identifying strategic alternatives and project approach to client questions, applying a solution-orientated approach and looking to add client value wherever possible

  • Developing of intellectual property for use on future engagements

  • Developing broader and deeper knowledge of consulting methodologies and life science know-how through on-the-job experience and training

  • Applying high attention to quality and detail with strong written and spoken English

  • Applying excellent PowerPoint and Excel skills, and ability to present information in compelling and creative ways (story telling through data, insights, effective slides)

  • Occasional management of more junior resources, such as associate consultants or interns

  • Working effectively in a remote environment, often with limited face-to-face contact with team members and client counterparts

  • However, working under supervision of a more senior member of the team, usually with daily alignments on operative tasks.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • B.S./B.A in relevant field of study required (life sciences or economic/managerial sciences, medical engineering).

  • 2-4 years of pharmaceutical, medical/health industry-related experience and/or 2-4 years management consulting experience

  • Understanding of life sciences business practices and the issues clients face in specific segments of responsibility

  • Strong conceptual, analytic and problem-solving skills

  • Strong knowledge of the market research development process

  • Strong quantitative and qualitative market research skills.

  • Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook

  • Ability to structure and use large amounts of data and other types of information from multiple sources to complete a final analysis of a business question/situations and make recommendations

  • Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines, and work on several projects and multiple tasks simultaneously

  • Demonstrated self-awareness and accountability

  • Ability to lead and own personal projects

  • Ability to establish credibility in front of clients at companies

  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately up to 10% of annual worktime, mainly for off-site company events)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, MS, MPH).

  • Background in International Pricing and Market Access, analytics and modelling/forecasting would be a plus to effectively lead Global Pricing and Market Access projects for key clients.

  • 2+ years of management consulting experience.

Additional Information

  • Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

  • Take Action I am empowered and hold myself accountable.

  • Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.

  • Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

title: Payment Operations Lead
description:
Overview

About Owner.com

Owner is the all-in-one platform that restaurants use to succeed online.

Thousands of restaurant owners use our tools to build their website, drive online orders, create their own branded app, manage their customer relationships, and set up marketing automations.

You can think of it as Shopify meets HubSpot, but specifically for restaurants.

Learn more about the problems we are solving for our customers here.

Our vision

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants–we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction

In just over 3 years we\'ve generated tens of millions in revenue, served millions of guests, and processed hundreds of millions of online orders.

More importantly, we’ve helped thousands of restaurant owners save their businesses - and not only survive, but thrive.

Our team

Our team grew from under 100 to nearly 200 talented people in 2024. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2025 to keep pace with our customer growth.

Where we work

Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

Why we’re looking for you

Owner.com is building the all-in-one platform that helps independent restaurants grow and thrive. Payments are core to our mission - restaurants depend on us to reliably process tens of millions of online orders today. We’re looking for a Payment Operations Lead to design and scale our payments operations, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and reliability as we expand from U.S-based restaurants into international markets.

This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.

The impact you will have

  • Design and implement scalable payment operations processes and controls, ensuring reliable reconciliation, dispute handling, and settlement.
  • Oversee operational risk management (onboarding reviews, transaction monitoring, chargebacks) and partner with Product/Analytics on risk model improvements.
  • Monitor and improve payment performance metrics (approval rates, chargeback ratios, settlement timeliness) to enhance merchant trust and retention.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering and Analytics to automate operational workflows, reduce manual intervention, and embed ops requirements into product design.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance and risk management as Owner.com evolves its payments infrastructure and prepares for new markets and payments channels.
  • Collaborate closely with Support to improve merchant experiences and streamline escalations.
  • Develop operational playbooks, dashboards, and reporting to provide visibility into performance and risk.
  • Lead remediation of operational incidents and drive continuous improvement.
  • Over time, hire and grow a high-performing Payment Operations team.

Who you’ll work with

  • Report directly to the GM of Payments and partner with leadership to shape Owner.com\’s payments strategy, expanding beyond online ordering into additional payment channels and technologies.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Support teams to embed and scale payments across the platform.
  • Align with Finance and Compliance on reconciliation, reporting, and regulatory needs.

What we’re looking for

  • 5–10 years of experience in payments, fintech, SaaS, or payment operations roles.
  • Direct experience with platform payments or marketplace models (Stripe, Adyen, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of payment performance levers (fraud, chargebacks, approval optimization, settlement) and regulatory frameworks (KYC/KYB, AML, PCI, card network rules).
  • Hands-on experience in operational risk management, including onboarding risk, transaction monitoring, and chargeback processes.
  • Proven ability to design scalable processes, implement controls, and own operational metrics.
  • Excellent problem-solving and data analysis skills; comfortable using tools/SQL to dive into payments data.
  • Demonstrated cross-functional collaboration skills with Product, Engineering, Support, and Finance.
  • 2+ years of experience leading or mentoring a team, with readiness and excitement to roll up sleeves as an individual contributor in the short term.

  • Ensure alignment with the broader team by collaborating with Marketing, Solutions Engineers, and Customer Success to deliver exceptional value to customers.
  • Use Salesforce to track and manage pipeline health, providing clear visibility into sales progress and forecasts.

About you?

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS sales, with proven success in managing large-scale deals and long sales cycles.

  • Deep understanding of enterprise sales cycles, procurement processes, and the ability to manage multi-stakeholder decisions.
  • Account-based selling experience and a proven track record of developing long-term relationships with enterprise customers.
  • Native-level Japanese proficiency and strong knowledge of Japanese business customs and protocols.

Why you should join Contentsquare

We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.

Here are a few we want to highlight:

  • Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year
  • Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies
  • Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)
  • Immediate eligibility for birthing and non-birthing parental leave
  • Wellbeing and Home Office allowances
  • A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work
  • Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success

Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors.     • Virtualization / Cloud computing concepts (provisioning, monitoring, orchestration, etc.)

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience supporting virtualized environments (KVM, Virtual Box, VMWare)

  • Active contribution to open-source projects/forum/code

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Testing and Validation

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.

Experience

Technical Skills

title: [BM] SR Data Architect – Google Cloud Focus
description:
Join to apply for the (BM) SR Data Architect – Google Cloud Focus role at Zallpy Digital .

We are a technology company focused on digital transformation, with a collaborative and inclusive culture. This 100% remote position offers opportunities to work across modern cloud-native data architectures and API-led integrations.

What You Will Do

  • Design, develop, and manage end-to-end data architecture: data models, storage solutions, data flows, and processing pipelines — prioritizing GCP-native services.
  • Lead GCP-native ingestion from Salesforce and NetSuite into BigQuery using BigQuery Data Transfer Service, Dataflow, Data Fusion, and orchestration with Cloud Composer.
  • Implement Salesforce pipelines with Bulk API (high-volume loads) and REST API (incremental sync), applying rate-limit handling (batch sizing, retries, exponential backoff).
  • Design NetSuite → BigQuery connectors with secure OAuth 2.0 or Token-Based authentication, incremental loading (lastModifiedDate, Saved Searches, SuiteQL), and schema evolution strategies.
  • Define Dataplex governance using Terraform — including metadata ingestion, policy tags, lineage tracking, RBAC, and Data Quality rules as CI/CD gates.
  • Apply a Terraform-first approach for provisioning all repeatable resources (BigQuery, Dataplex, IAM, policy tags, Apigee components), ensuring consistency and version control.
  • Integrate AWS data sources (e.g., Redshift) into GCP and support the deprecation of legacy tools (e.g., MuleSoft) in favor of API-led architectures via Apigee.
  • Continuously evaluate architecture for scalability, performance, cost-efficiency, and security.
  • Standardize and maintain documentation of architecture patterns, processes, and runbooks.
  • Partner with Data Engineers, Analysts, and Data Stewards to translate business requirements into robust data solutions.
  • Lead architecture reviews, best-practice sessions, and mentor peers to enhance team capabilities.

What We Are Looking For

  • Advanced/Fluent English for technical discussions and stakeholder communication.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Significant experience in data architecture with a strong GCP focus.
  • Hands-on expertise in BigQuery, Dataflow, Data Fusion, Cloud Composer, Dataplex, and Cloud Storage.
  • Proven experience with Salesforce (Bulk/REST API) and NetSuite pipelines (OAuth 2.0 / Token-Based, incremental loads, schema evolution).
  • Experience with Apigee Integration for API-led connectivity and secure API exposure.
  • Strong background in security and compliance for regulated data environments.
  • Proficiency with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, warehousing, governance, lineage, and quality practices.
  • Cross-cloud experience (GCP and AWS).
  • Ability to design scalable, high-performance architectures and enforce technical standards.

It Will Be a Plus If You Have

  • Experience migrating from MuleSoft or similar legacy platforms to cloud-native/API-led solutions.

Where You Will Work

title: Microservices Engineer
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is a general selection track for teams that focus on back-end REST API microservices engineering in Go and Python. It covers all levels of seniority. Apply here if you are an outstanding engineer with crisp and well-articulated views on APIs, microservice design, engineering processes and DevOps. Our services need to scale to handle millions of Ubuntu clients, and collaboration across thousands of community members. As Ubuntu has been embraced by mainstream enterprise computing through the adoption of cloud and developer-centric tech strategy, the quality of these services has become more important to customers and users. We are growing our teams and aim to level up our insights on scalability, performance, resilience and DevOps practices. Key areas of interest for us are: API design, documentation, and governance; database performance design considerations; multi-region service delivery for resilience and performance; fuzzing and other proactive security analysis techniques; tracing and profiling for distributed systems insights; next-generation DevOps practices.

Responsibilities

  • Write high-quality, well-designed, and robust software that works at scale
  • Design APIs and software architecture for collegial review
  • Write tests that validate software behaviour
  • Build and maintain reliable, fault-tolerant applications and services
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality solutions to resolve them
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Discuss, contribute to, and collaborate across teams at Canonical
  • Work from home with global travel twice annually for company events

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Proficiency in Python and / or Go
  • History of writing modern, maintainable software
  • Experience with relational and non-relational database systems
  • Continuous integration and continuous delivery experience
  • Experience with systems programming or scalable web services
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with container tech such as LXD, Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains
  • Experience with cross-compilation
  • Experience with hyperscale public clouds and / or private clouds
  • Experience with designing, building, and running distributed systems
  • Performance engineering and security experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.
This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Barcelona, Brazil, and Colombia.
 What you'll do:

  • Conduct thorough brand and website audits to understand our clients’ key value propositions, core products, and brand aesthetics and identify opportunities to successfully market them and make them stand out in the marketplace.

Overview

Join to apply for the IoT Solutions Architecture Manager role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are hiring an IoT Solutions Architecture Manager to lead a regionally-focused team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services activities, by helping customers with solution architecture, design and delivery.

Location: This is a remote role, running a team in one of three Geos, Americas, EMEA or APAC. You will therefore need to be located in one of those three Geos to manage that specific team that spans a few timezones from you.

Our Internet of Things mission is to enable companies to make fleets of very secure connected devices. Canonical provides the base Ubuntu OS and kernel, with secure update and management mechanisms.   • Ability to manage a small team
  • Experience with customer engagements
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • An ability to communicate the business benefits of technology
  • An humble learner and quick study

Other desirable traits include RTOS experience, additional languages (both the programming and human kinds), and previous experience working in a remote-first, diverse, distributed company.

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. You’ll be responsible for building and maintaining robust, efficient data pipelines and models that support everything from operational reporting to product insights. This is a hands-on role focused on developing and optimizing the modern data stack — using tools like dbt, Airflow, and cloud-based data platforms.

If you’re passionate about building clean, reliable data systems and have experience working with high-volume transactional or payments data, we’d love to hear from you.

Location: This role is a full-time remote position. #LI-REMOTE

  • Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using dbt and Apache Airflow to transform raw payment and customer data into usable datasets.
  • Develop and optimize data models that support analytics, dashboards, and data science workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and analytics teams to define data needs and deliver reliable, scalable solutions.
  • Monitor and improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of data pipelines.
  • Implement data quality checks, anomaly detection, and alerts to ensure trust in our data.
  • Manage and optimize usage of our cloud data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift).
  • Contribute to internal tooling, documentation, and best practices that help scale our data operations.

  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role working with modern data tools.
  • Strong experience with dbt for data modeling and transformation.
  • Proficiency with Airflow or other orchestration tools.
  • Deep understanding of SQL and data warehousing concepts.
  • Experience with cloud-based data warehouses
  • Solid programming skills in Python for data pipeline development and automation.
  • Strong grasp of data architecture, including building for scale, modularity, and maintainability.
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD workflows in a data engineering context.
  • Strong experience with data governance principles, including data cataloging, lineage, classification, and security.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience working with payments data, such as transaction logs, settlement files, or ledger systems.
  • Familiarity with tools for data observability and monitoring (e.g., Monte Carlo, Great Expectations).
  • Exposure to real-time or near-real-time data processing frameworks (e.g., Kafka, Spark Streaming).
  • Experience working in a fintech or high-growth startup environment.

Why Join Us:

  • Work on high-impact data systems powering a growing fintech payments platform.
  • Own and influence the core data infrastructure from early stages.
  • Collaborate with a smart, driven team that values autonomy and continuous improvement.

  • Contribute to, improve, and maintain team documentation about client systems and infrastructure, procedures, policies, and schedules.
  • Gather and document information about client environments through audit activities, and analyze the information to identify opportunities for improvement and application of best practices.
  • Work collaboratively with teammates to contribute to the continuous improvement of our working culture.
  • Act as a technology leader for clients, as well as drive client discussions on technology road maps.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation in an escalation capacity.

What do we need from you?

  • Experience working with Google and AWS Clouds (including infrastructure as code deployment with Cloud Formation, Terraform, OpsWorks, etc)
  • Scripting and automation of administrative tasks using Python and Scala is a must
  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture and container technologies (Kubernetes is a must, Docker, LXC, etc)
  • Clear understanding of software development lifecycles and best practices from an infrastructure point of view (PRs, merge, rebase, etc)
  • Understanding the end-to-end operations of a ‘Business System’ vs components.
  • Comprehensive systems hardware and network troubleshooting experience

  • TCP/IP networking, NIC bonding, and network services configuration (DNS, NTP, DHCP, SMTP, etc)
  • Operation and administration of virtual infrastructure, including experience with at least one hypervisor (VMware, Hyper-V, KVM, etc.)

  • Experience with the design, development, and deployment of Puppet
  • System and application error investigation, troubleshooting of access/availability issues including deep multi-system root cause analysis
  • Experience managing networking devices, such as switches and firewalls from a variety of vendors
  • Solid understanding of DevOps tools, processes, and culture
  • Ability to pick up new technologies quickly
  • Ability to provide accurate work scheduling and task estimations for work delivery

What do you get in return?

Who You Are

Based in Washington, DC, Quorum is a fast-growing software company and is the leading provider of workflow software and information services for government affairs professionals across the corporations, non-profits, associations, and governmental end-markets. Quorum allows users to manage stakeholder engagement, launch grassroots advocacy campaigns, and track legislative activity at all levels of government, including federal, state and local.

title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labelling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure , we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Job description

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure , we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

The team

We’re hiring Data Analysts to join our Compliance Enterprise Client Data Office team, working remotely from India! This role is centered on building and enhancing compliance dashboarding, analytics, and insights — the core responsibility of the position. The candidate must be passionate about creating dashboards that deliver clear, actionable insights, as this will be the main focus of the role.

As a Data Analyst, you will own core responsibilities such as designing scalable compliance dashboards, analytics, and metrics, architecting automated pipelines and audit-ready regulatory reports, and translating plain-language business or regulatory requests into precise data models. You’ll partner closely with leaders across Compliance, Risk, and other stakeholders to strengthen our compliance posture and ensure regulators and executives have visibility into accurate, meaningful insights. Your ability to contextualize data within the broader business and risk landscape, and communicate those insights to both technical and non-technical audiences, will be essential.

In addition to these core responsibilities, you will also provide ad-hoc support where needed: managing data requests, assisting with regulatory reporting, supporting automation and peer code reviews, and developing tactical solutions that free up Product and Engineering teams to focus on long-term improvements. The ability to juggle multiple projects simultaneously, communicate effectively in a fully remote environment, and leverage AI to create scalable frameworks will be key to success.

Ultimately, this is a critical role shaping Kraken’s compliance and client data strategy, aligning data practices with ambitious business objectives, and navigating the complexities of an evolving regulatory landscape with rigor, creativity, and precision.

The opportunity

  • Develop and maintain high-quality data sources in partnership with Data and Engineering teams.

  • Build key datasets and data pipelines using Python and ETL frameworks (e.g., Airflow).

  • Design and automate reports, dashboards, and compliance metrics ensuring consistency, accuracy, and actionable insights for business partners across the business.

  • Work closely with Regional Compliance Officers to deliver audit-ready regulatory reports.

  • Build client data dashboards for Executive Leadership, providing insights on trends, KPIs, demographics, and growth opportunities.

  • Monitor and improve client data quality by identifying issues, driving remediations, and coordinating timely resolutions.

  • Automate compliance governance controls and monitoring to ensure processes operate as expected.

  • Provide cross-functional support during peak periods (requirements definition, backlog management, QA triage) to maintain delivery timelines.

  • Develop ad-hoc compliance solutions to enable Product Development and Engineering teams to focus on long-term improvements.

  • Support ad-hoc data requests for audits, exams, risk assessments, and day-to-day business needs.

Skills you should HODL

  • 3+ years industry experience in data analysis and data management

  • 2+ years experience in Compliance and Regulatory Reporting areas

  • Advanced knowledge of SQL, scripting languages and database concepts with a record of performing data analysis using a scripting language

  • Expert in Python for data analysis, automation, and building scalable applications, with high proficiency in libraries, frameworks, and scripting for complex workflows

  • Hands-on experience with, AWS, Airflow, Cursor, and BI tools such as QuickSight or Superset

  • Experience using compliance and investigation tools (e.g., Hummingbird, Moody’s RDC, Chainalysis, Elliptic) to support regulatory reporting, monitoring, and risk analysis.

  • Ability to synthesize ambiguous regulatory requests into technical requirements

  • Familiarity with data warehouse development and best practices

  • Ability to clearly present reports, dashboards and complex results to Executives

  • You believe wholeheartedly in the cypherpunk, libertarian values outlined in Kraken’s Tentaclements document.

  • Must be based in India and fluent in English

Nice to Haves

  • Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related technical field.

  • Knowledge of AML/FCC, Sanctions, KYC, MiCA, MiFID, or Data Governance regulations.

  • Passionate about crypto with deep knowledge of emerging trends and tokens beyond blue chips

About Ruby Labs

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at:

About the Role

We are seeking a talented and innovative Ad Creative Producer to join our dynamic marketing team at Ruby Labs. This full-time role is central to driving our advertising creative process across multiple consumer-focused brands. You will be responsible for developing new ad concepts, managing production timelines, and collaborating with various teams to ensure that our creatives captivate and convert. You will work directly under the Ad Creative Lead and coordinate with User Acquisition Managers to refine and optimize advertising strategies based on performance data.

Responsibilities

  • Creative Development: lead ideation and conceptualization of new ad creatives that resonate with diverse audiences and enhance customer acquisition; stay ahead of industry trends and collaborate with design teams to transform ideas into compelling creatives that align with brand values and campaign goals.
  • Project Management: oversee production processes to deliver projects on time and with the intended creative vision; coordinate with designers, user acquisition managers, and other team members to ensure smooth workflow and high-quality outputs.
  • Performance Analysis: work with User Acquisition Managers to analyze ad creative performance, generate and test hypotheses in A/B testing, and provide regular reports on impact and effectiveness.
  • Market and Competitor Analysis: conduct research to understand market benchmarks and creative standards; identify trends and propose innovative solutions for better market positioning and customer engagement.
  • Collaborative Efforts: liaise between creative teams and user acquisition managers to optimize creatives based on real-time data and facilitate brainstorming to boost acquisition and retention.

Qualifications

Experience: 3+ years in creative production or similar roles, preferably in tech-focused or consumer product companies; proven track record of managing creative projects from inception to completion; strong portfolio of high-performing digital ads.

Technical Skills: expertise in digital advertising platforms; proficiency with project management and collaboration tools; ability to analyze data to draw actionable insights; up-to-date knowledge of AI tools used in creative production to generate innovative ad creatives.

Personal Qualities: strong creative vision, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, detail-oriented with strong organizational abilities to manage multiple projects.

Adaptability: ability to adapt to new technologies and marketing changes; willingness to experiment with new ideas.

Location

Ruby Labs operates in the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome as long as they are located within approximately ±4 hours of CET to ensure collaboration during working hours.

Benefits

  • Remote Work Environment: work from anywhere with flexible arrangements.
  • Unlimited PTO: paid time off to recharge.
  • Paid National Holidays: paid time off on holidays.
  • Company-provided MacBook: equipment provided as needed.
  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: flexibility and autonomy with associated benefits.

Interview Process

After submitting your application, a review typically takes 3 to 5 days. If there is potential fit, the next steps may include: recruiter screening, task assignment, and final interview (duration depending on process).

Life at Ruby Labs

We are a community united in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation. We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity. title: Senior Specialist, Employee Relations - LATAM
description:
Overview

About Remote Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform. If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You’re not just part of a team; you’re at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.

The Senior Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations & Transitions independently manages all employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance, excellent quality and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources.

As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Senior Specialist is also expected to drive process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and resolve complex end-to-end employee exits with minimal supervision across multiple international jurisdictions, prioritizing a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and employees.
  • Provide sound and trusted guidance with an elevated level of knowledge on key jurisdictions, and manage clients' requests on various HR matters, including but not limited to termination, resignation and transfer procedures, employment contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.
  • Independently lead and facilitate meetings with clients and external employees, including but not limited to workforce reduction consultation meetings, administrative hearings, negotiations in separations and settlements, providing guidance on terminations, and delivering termination outcomes.
  • Influence and negotiate positive outcomes in complex terminations, successfully navigating and directing multiple stakeholders with competing interests through a complicated, involved and sometimes lengthy process.
  • Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.
  • Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.
  • Process offboarding on Remote's internal HRIS platform, collaborating with various internal stakeholders, such as Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, among other verticals, to ensure all aspects of the employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.
  • Act as the first point of informal escalation as a trusted colleague with good judgment, by way of providing expertise, mentoring and guidance to more junior team members.
  • Provide comprehensive guidance on Remote's Employee Relations resources, helping clients navigate complex workplace scenarios.
  • Conduct thorough preliminary assessments of workplace concerns, identifying key facts, applicable local regulations, and potential paths forward.
  • Serve as a trusted resource for internal and external stakeholders on employee relations matters, ensuring appropriate handling of complex cases.
  • Guide clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches, documentation requirements, and best practices for handling difficult situations.
  • Track and monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow-up and appropriate coordination with relevant stakeholders.
  • Be the subject-matter expert and proactively resolve internal and external queries on all offboarding and first-level employee relations matters in conjunction with Lifecycle's internal stakeholders.
  • Actively identify opportunities, advocate for and drive process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and employee experience through the offboarding and employee relations processes.
  • Determine methods, procedures and standards on new assignments. Exercise judgment in selecting methods, evaluating, adapting complex techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results taking into account wider Lifecycle and Remote needs.

Qualifications

  • Extensive experience as an HR Advisor or HR Business Partner, with generalist HR competencies and exposure across the employee lifecycle.
  • Tertiary qualifications in HR/labour relations/employment law considered a plus.
  • Proven experience with a strong background in independently managing voluntary and involuntary exits (terminations) with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; and providing comprehensive HR advice and guidance on employment laws and regulations, spanning various jurisdictions.
  • Understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline approaches, and workplace investigation fundamentals.
  • Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues and apply problem-solving skills to independently (occasionally with minimal supervision) arrive at solutions, undertake research and translate this into usable team resources, provide practical solutions and effectively communicate recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders when operating in ambiguous and unfamiliar environments.
  • Superior communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to independently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, while conveying authority and expertise as the representative of Remote, and maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.
  • Business-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.
  • Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying, developing and implementing opportunities for automation and champion best practice.
  • Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record-keeping and data integrity.
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.
  • Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment while successfully balancing multiple competing priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.
  • Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, and ability to inspire others.

Practical details

  • You'll report to: Manager Employee Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Team: Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Location: LATAM
  • Start date: As soon as possible

Remote Compensation and Benefits

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we strive to pay above in-location rates. At Remote we use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while hiring globally.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $41,900 to $94,300 USD. The actual base pay for the successful candidate depends on location, transferable skills, work experience, training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, internal mobility is a key element of our culture of employee growth and development. All compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

Benefits

  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • learning budget
  • home office budget & IT equipment
  • budget for local in-person social events or co-working spaces

How to apply

  • Please fill out the form below and upload your CV in PDF format.
  • Submit your application and CV in English.
  • If you don’t have an up-to-date CV, you can provide your LinkedIn profile instead.

Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. We ask and encourage anyone who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter. We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.

At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity. To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines, please check the guidelines. Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

description:
Overview

National Consultant for the development of Risk Communication toolkit and course, Brasilia (home-based), Brazil, (6 months).

Join to apply for the National Consultant role at UNICEF. In conflict and disaster, children suffer first and suffer most. UNICEF works to strengthen the links between humanitarian action and development work, delivering a continuum of support. In Brazil, UNICEF supports child-centred disaster risk reduction interventions and emergency responses, such as the Venezuelan migration outflow and the drought in the Amazon Region. In the last two years, UNICEF contributed to the Yanomami public health emergency and the response to the floods in Rio Grande do Sul. UNICEF’s crosscutting focus includes Social and Behaviour Change (SBC), and Risk Communication and Community Engagement (RCCE) is a key component of preparedness and response.

Under the guidance of the Social and Behaviour Change Officer, in coordination with the Emergency Specialist and the RCCE Specialist, the consultant will support UNICEF in producing a Toolkit and course on Risk Communication and Community Engagement in Brazil, liaising with all field offices that respond to humanitarian situations in the country. The consultancy covers a 6-month period and aims to develop an RCCE Toolkit and a short RCCE course for public managers involved in emergency preparedness and response in Brazil.

Work assignments and deliverables

  • RCCE Toolkit: Mapping — Map UNICEF's existing materials/tools since 2018 (migration response, COVID-19, and recent emergencies) and organize the materials in an online repository. Deliverables include a cloud-based, catalogued repository and a document listing mapped materials. Timeline: after 30 days of contract signature. Budget: 10% of consultancy fee.
  • RCCE Toolkit: Message Matrix — Develop a comprehensive matrix with child-centered key messages by emergency type (drought, smoke/fires, floods) for each of the five UNICEF Goal Areas (Health and Nutrition, WASH, Education, Child Protection, Social Policy). Messages will be used for advocacy and field contexts; the template will be developed in coordination with UNICEF. Deliverables: a spreadsheet with priority messages per type of emergency and area. Timeline: after 60 days. Budget: 20% of consultancy fee.
  • Child-centred RCCE Course — Develop an 8-hour training course (with 4-hour and 2-hour options) in Portuguese, including at least one practical co-construction exercise. Provide an online version adapted for the EV.G platform, with two short tutorial videos. The consultant is not responsible for platform programming but will provide scripts. Deliverables include facilitator’s guide, participant workbook, planning checklist, presentation, and online course script with quizzes and media guidelines. Timeline: after 90 days. Budget: 20% of consultancy fee.
  • RCCE Toolkit: Testing — Conduct pretesting of key messages and draft materials with affected populations and local partners, with no travel required (UNICEF will implement in selected locations). Deliverables: short report on testing, methodologies, and adaptations. Timeline: after 120 days. Budget: 15% of consultancy fee.
  • RCCE Toolkit: Materials — Produce final materials for the toolkit (25 posters, 25 card series, 25 flyers, 25 radio scripts) with a user guide and a cloud repository for high-quality PDFs, PNGs, and .doc files. Timeline: after 150 days. Budget: 35% of consultancy fee.

Travel plan

No travel planned for this consultancy.

Minimum qualifications

  • A university degree in social and behavioural sciences, social communication, sociology, anthropology, psychology, education, public relations, or related field.
  • At least 4 years of professional experience in RCCE, CwC, SBC, C4D or related areas; experience in humanitarian settings and producing content for affected populations; portfolio required.
  • Knowledge of children’s rights issues (CRC and the Statute of the Child and Adolescent is an asset).
  • Ability to manage relationships with partners, including government counterparts and communities; strong writing and communication skills in Portuguese.
  • Experience in a UN system agency or humanitarian/development organization is an asset.

Language proficiency

  • Fluency in Portuguese is required. English is an asset.

Financial proposal

  • Financial proposal must include all-inclusive fees (lump sum, travel costs, subsistence) based on deliverables and days requested.

Remarks

UNICEF’s Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability guide all work. UNICEF provides inclusive accommodation where possible. UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on exploitation, abuse, discrimination, and safeguarding; background checks may be required. Consultants are responsible for visa and health insurance and for tax obligations according to local laws. SARS-CoV-2 vaccination status may be required for on-site assignments.

Join to apply for the Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representative, Manager and Director role at Canonical .

Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives like public cloud, data science, AI, engineering, and IoT. Our customers include top public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders across sectors. We operate with a global, distributed team of 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries, with few office-based roles. We are hiring Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales representatives, managers, and directors to expand in industries such as Automotive, Medical Devices, Industrial Systems, Robotics, and Telco, as well as consumer electronics. Candidates should be technically skilled and familiar with embedded Linux and RTOS. We are expanding globally, so candidates from nearly any country with reasonable business access to a major market are welcome. We will also hire Sales Managers and Regional Sales Directors as we grow.

Our Ubuntu IoT solutions, including Ubuntu Core, are at the forefront of security and resilience for high-end devices. Our customers range from consumer and industrial electronics to automotive and robotics. We are continuously expanding our offerings to enhance security, management, and developer experience across small Linux environments and devices. We have added real-time Linux capabilities and are working towards certifications to ensure reliability and security.

This role involves prospecting and strategic account development, requiring energy, ambition, and focus. Success depends on your ability to position and sell open source, services, and software solutions at all organizational levels, especially to departments developing embedded software and IoT devices. Familiarity with key sectors is advantageous.

Customers value the ability to obtain security compliance and support for open source solutions from a single provider. Our goal is to offer more solutions than any other vendor, enabling deployment across all clouds, compute types, and applications. Canonical provides licensed enterprise software, support, managed services, consulting, and training for Ubuntu and open source applications in cloud, data center, and IoT ecosystems. We are experiencing steady growth and operate in a mostly remote environment with leadership across many countries. We believe talent is globally distributed and aim to build a diverse team of exceptional leaders.

Our hiring process is rigorous, taking three to six months, and is suited for ambitious, long-term career-oriented candidates. We seek individuals with high ability and character, committed to teamwork, diligence, and excellence. We value five qualities in our sales team:

  • Empathy for customers
  • High intellect

While Ubuntu’s wide adoption provides a strong market foundation, success requires proactive relationship-building and territory development. You will be responsible for managing pipeline, planning, and reporting, using professional tools like Salesforce. Location: We are expanding in EMEA, APAC, and the Americas.

The role entails:

  • Building and executing a territory plan
  • Collaborating with marketing to promote our brand
  • Developing pipeline via outreach and industry events
  • Closing contracts to meet/exceed targets

  • Working with IoT Field Engineers
